headline: Folarin Balogun's ban is lifted by FIFA, allowing U.S. striker to play Belgium
context: In an unusual move, FIFA's Disciplinary Committee announced that it would delay Folarin Balogun's one-game red card ban. It came after President Trump spoke to FIFA President Gianni Infantino.

sources.name: NPR
